title: Register MemoryAnalyticsService in createKernel() for demo/MSW environments
body:
`/api/v1/analytics/query` and `/api/v1/analytics/meta` return 405 in demo/MSW environments because the kernel has no `analytics` service registered, causing `HttpDispatcher` to skip the handler.

### Changes

- **Import `MemoryAnalyticsService`** from `@objectstack/driver-memory` alongside existing `InMemoryDriver` import
- **Auto-generate cube definitions** from app config objects via `buildCubesFromConfig()` — creates `count`/`sum`/`avg` measures for numeric fields and `string`/`time` dimensions for scalar/date fields
- **Register analytics service** on the kernel before MSWPlugin loads, with a thin adapter bridging the `getMetadata()` ↔ `getMeta()` method name mismatch between `HttpDispatcher` and `IAnalyticsService`
- **Add analytics routes to broker shim** (`analytics.query`, `analytics.meta`, `analytics.sql`)

```ts
const cubes = buildCubesFromConfig(appConfig);
const memoryAnalytics = new MemoryAnalyticsService({ driver, cubes });
kernel.registerService('analytics', {
  query: (query: any) => memoryAnalytics.query(query),
  getMeta: (cubeName?: string) => memoryAnalytics.getMeta(cubeName),
  getMetadata: () => memoryAnalytics.getMeta(),
  generateSql: (query: any) => memoryAnalytics.generateSql(query),
});
```

No new dependencies — `MemoryAnalyticsService` already ships with `@objectstack/driver-memory` which is an existing dependency.

> <issue_title>Register analytics service in createKernel() for demo and MSW environments</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## Problem
> 
> The demo (and MSW/test) environments in ObjectUI do not properly enable analytics capabilities:
> - The API route POST `/api/v1/analytics/query` and `/api/v1/analytics/meta` return 405 errors because the ObjectStack kernel is missing the `analytics` service registration.
> - Although `MemoryAnalyticsService` exists and is fully implemented in `@objectstack/spec` and `driver-memory`, it is not wired up in `createKernel()` when bootstrapping for demo/MSW/test environments. Thus, the analytics endpoints are not functional even though all dependencies are present.
> 
> ## Reproduction
> Go to [https://demo.objectui.org](https://demo.objectui.org) and inspect network requests for `/api/v1/analytics/query`. You will see a 405 error and MSW passthrough, indicating the kernel is missing analytics service wiring.
> 
> ## Solution Proposal
> - In `apps/console/src/mocks/createKernel.ts` (and any similar "createKernel" setups for MSW, Storybook, or Demo):
>     - Instantiate `MemoryAnalyticsService` from `@objectstack/driver-memory`, passing the correct `InMemoryDriver` and cube configuration (the same one used for other in-memory objects).
>     - Add a line:
>       ```ts
>       ctx.registerService('analytics', new MemoryAnalyticsService({ driver, cubes: [.../* config */] }));
>       ```
>     - Ensure this runs before MSWPlugin is loaded, so dispatcher can route analytics requests to a real implementation.
> 
> - Update any tests/Storybook/preview setups that need analytics endpoints for dashboards, reporting, or BI widgets.
> 
> ## Impact
> - Enables live analytics queries and metadata endpoints for ObjectUI demo, Storybook, MSW, and local dev environments
> - Fixes 405 passthrough and makes `/api/v1/analytics/*` APIs available for dashboards, charts, grid, and BI views
> - Unblocks frontend teams from building/test-driving analytics plugins and SDUI dashboards using the pure frontend kernel
>

> - Ensure correct cube config is injected to reflect available metrics and dimensions.
> - Add code comments clarifying why this registration is needed only in demo/MSW/dev environments.
> </issue_description>
